brand_rules.positioning: Pakistan's #1 Physical + Omnichannel Patient Acquisition Engine for Hospitals, Clinics, Dental Practices & Aesthetic Centers.
brand_rules.core_guarantee: Dominate Your 10km Radius in 30 Days — Or We Work For Free.
four_pillars: 10km Physical Ground Game (In-person corporate, school, housing society, pharmacy & community outreach)
Dedicated Medical Telemarketing Unit (Direct outbound calling, corporate HR tie-ups, and instant inquiry-to-chair conversion)
10km Data Extraction & Hyper-Local Social Retargeting (Scraping and retargeting every high-intent household in a 10km radius)
100+ Weekly Content Engine (Filming once and repurposing into 100+ short-form videos, reels, and authority assets every single week)
brand_rules.strict_exclusion: Never mention Razes or B2B agency lead generation. ClientKit is 100% exclusively for hospitals, clinics, doctors, dental practices, and healthcare facilities.
